summary: Kandi Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K reporting the resignation of independent director Lin Yi effective May 31, 2026, and the appointment of Yang Rui as his replacement. Lin's resignation was for personal reasons with no disagreement with the company. Rui, age 54, a senior engineer in automotive fields, will serve as independent director and on the Compensation and Nominating Committees, receiving an annual salary of RMB 60,000 (~USD 8,823). No material terms or prices are involved. This is a routine board succession event with no strategic or transactional significance.
